title: Major Murphy tells Vallée about 1943 saucers and their psychotronic effect

tellings.quote: And he points to 1943 and he says, "You know, what if someone was experimenting with this technology? It turns out its real advantage wasn't its flight capabilities, but its psychotronic effect."

plain: A man called Major Murphy is said to have told Jacques Vallée, a UFO researcher, in an account in Vallée's book Messengers of Deception, that someone may have been experimenting with saucer technology as early as 1943, and that its "real advantage wasn't its flight capabilities, but its psychotronic effect", meaning its power over people's minds. The researcher Jason Simosa summarises this from the book. If true, it would mean such craft were developed as tools for affecting how people think.
